recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the seed by fixing the remaining current-build example mismatch; any broader editorial choice to add CodeSystem.system values to all Subscription channel examples should be handled separately.
issue_request: FHIR-20476 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that Subscription.channel.type allow extensible channel mechanisms; the accepted resolution changed the channel type to Coding and the binding to extensible.
initial_application: Jira records commits a8762c404cabbf352bfaa710016d436b85b757b9 and d6b6a5e68bbfc8eb086c2bf82744432d6af9e788 as the initial application. They moved Subscription toward the R5 channel model and made the admission JSON channel value Coding-shaped, but the JSON example still retained the obsolete channel property and a ValueSet URL in Coding.system.
additional_context: FHIR-23738 is the same Subscription redesign family and explicitly lists FHIR-20476, flattening Subscription.channel, and changing Subscription.channelType to Coding. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Subscription active, and source/subscription/list-Subscription-examples.xml includes Subscription/admission. The authoritative StructureDefinition already has Subscription.channelType as Coding with an extensible binding, and the XML examples already use channelType. Confluence and Zulip evidence corroborates the vote and current R5 extensible-channel interpretation.
reconciliation: Changed source/subscription/subscription-admission.json from channel to channelType and removed the incorrect ValueSet URL system, matching the current StructureDefinition and the parallel XML admission example's Coding shape.
